focus: One shell owner, one viewport/drawer/mobile-nav runtime, non-blocking route transitions, compact responsive layouts, production-scoped Teacher/Admin/Student workflows, and fail-closed backend compatibility for long-term use.
pwa: installable phone/tablet/desktop; one adaptive shell; phone/tablet interactions never auto-enter native fullscreen on first touch; camera lifecycle is race-safe; explicit fullscreen remains available; offline shell/draft compatibility preserved.
copy_protection: system-wide UI deterrence for selection/copy/cut/context menu/drag; input fields and Admin CODE copy are allowed; sensitive data remains protected server-side
relationship_hardening: subject_enrollments.user_id and exam_attempts.user_id are explicit profile embed paths; actor fields use auth.users to avoid PostgREST ambiguity
